description: Built March 1977; delivered 15 March 1977; registered 8 April 1977 as CCCP-88259 to the Kazakh Civil Aviation Directorate at Zhana-Semey; re-registered UN-88259 in 1992-93; to Semey Avia 1993; withdrawn 2010 and stored at Zhana-Semey; plinthed beside the terminal in September 2011; year_built from the registry's stated build month
